annotations.title: Check a page against its baseline

description: Website change monitoring, step two: re-fetch a page saved with monitor.snapshot and get whether it changed, how old the baseline is, and a written summary of the differences. Input: url. $0.50 per call. Returns: url, title, changed, baseline_age_seconds, change_summary, model.
name: hubvibe_monitor_check

outputSchema.description: The 200 body of every paid /work call. `result` is the worker's own output (its schema is per route); everything else is the same on all 38 routes. A receipt for the job is at `receipt_url`.

billing_warning.description: Present only when the charge was recorded with a caveat.

price_usd.description: What this call cost, in USD.

provenance.description: How the result was produced: which providers ran and how long each took.

attempts.description: Provider attempts made, including retries and failovers.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds for the whole job.

steps.description: Every step the job ran, in order.

reason.description: Failure reason, on a failed step.

receipt_url.description: Where to fetch the machine-readable receipt (free, no payment).

baseline_age_seconds.description: Seconds since the baseline was taken.

change_summary.description: What changed, in words; or that nothing did.
examples: The pricing section now lists a $0.15 bundle; the headline is unchanged.

changed.description: Whether the readable text differs from the baseline.

model.description: Model that summarised the diff; present only when something changed.

status.description: Present only on a delivered result.

worker.description: Catalog name of the worker that ran.

outputSchema.title: monitor.check response

title: Check a page against its baseline
